setup.title: No watch data yet
setup.intro: The watch data comes from the iPhone app Health Auto Export (Premium). Set up two automations of the kind REST API:

steps.text: , a space and your token. The token is not set on the server yet: add a line WATCH_TOKEN=… (24 or more letters and digits) to /opt/stacks/logger/.env and restart the core.

First automation: Health Metrics with Step Count, Active Energy, Apple Exercise Time, Resting Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability, Walking + Running Distance, Flights Climbed, Sleep Analysis and Heart Rate; Summarize Data on, by hour.
Second automation: Workouts (no route data needed).
Sync every 30 minutes; Background App Refresh on. The phone sends only while it is unlocked now and then.

setup.note: Each run sends yesterday and today again; the logger keeps every reading once. Nothing goes to the Google Sheet.
